name: How do I choose a contractor for mobility improvement remodeling?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for mobility improvement remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for mobility improvement remodeling, look for experience in accessible design and renovations. Ask for references and view portfolios of similar projects. Ensure they understand ADA guidelines, even if not strictly required for residential work, as it demonstrates a commitment to accessibility. Verify licenses, insurance, and read reviews. A good contractor will also conduct a thorough assessment of your home and discuss your specific needs and budget in detail.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessible design, strong references, proper licensing, and insurance, who understands your specific needs.
